b.x: This does not set a date, does not announce a war, and does not turn fear into proof. The count says which risk is highest now, and the step for this week. One sign is a note. Three independent signs, in the same direction, are the most an honest civilian can call a forecast.

The person who notices early does not have a gift separate from attention. They have the habit of comparing. How this place is when it is ordinary. How this week is when it is ordinary. The future you can foresee is already embedded in the present, in pieces. The flood does not start in the water in the room. It starts in the low house, the drain, the rain the street cannot take. The fire does not start in the flame. It starts in the hot outlet and the single hall. The strange time does not start in the film. It starts when the same product is missing twice, and people who never stored anything start storing. To foresee is to add those pieces. Without adding, you only feel. Feeling is not a count.

Each lens has five signs. You mark only what is fact, seen or known, not what you fear. Zero or one: a note. You keep it. You do not change the week. Two: watch. One concrete thing, small, and you look again in a few days. Three or more, in the same lens: a count. Then a forecast exists, and it is narrow. It does not say the day. It says the direction. If two lenses tie at three or more, water comes before fire, fire before the strange time, the strange time before conflict. Because what kills faster commands the step. The lens of you does not add into the world. It dirties the count. Bad sleep, rehearsing the end, wanting to tell so you are seen, a tight body in an ordinary room: that is you. Fear is worth zero. If that lens reaches three, today's forecast does not count. You sleep. You count tomorrow.
Nothing to foresee. One sign, or none, is a note. Do not manufacture the second so the count becomes interesting.
0/5 You, which does not enter the sum
